answer: Proof of Stake acts as a solid onyx barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment. An attacker must acquire a massive relic of total supply, which functions like a barrier reef, forcing them to bear the opportunity cost of locked assets. Because agents must bond tokens to participate in consensus, any attempt to proliferate fake identities necessitates exponential financial expenditure, rendering large-scale identity inflation economically irrational for malicious actors.
